lead: Competitive intelligence tracking reveals active EFB and flight planning deployment announcements across major vendors, with IFS securing multiple customer wins including LCC carrier segments. Meanwhile, Jeppesen and Lufthansa Systems maintain high marketing and product feature release volumes.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple Airline Wins Including LCCs
insights.finding: IFS successfully captured multiple airline customer agreements for its IFS EFBOne platform, including regional and LCC segment carriers such as fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC.
insights.caveat: Captured text indicates public vendor wins and deployments during the rolling year period.

insights.title: Aviobook Expands Briefing Capabilities and Releases 26.3
insights.finding: Aviobook released AvioBook version 26.3 featuring customizable seat swap confirmations and added a dedicated airline notice section to its NOTAMs module.
insights.aviation_context: Enhancements target cockpit crew workflow efficiency during pre-flight briefings.

insights.title: Aviobook Signs Long-Term EFB Agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook secured a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to deploy the AvioBook Flight EFB platform across its pilot fleet.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a network carrier connecting Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

insights.title: Jeppesen Leads Capture Volume with ForeFlight Enhancements
insights.finding: Jeppesen maintained the highest captured signal and product launch volume among competitors, driven by ForeFlight Dispatch updates and NBAA-BACE announcements.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight Dispatch caters primarily to business and commercial aviation flight planning.
insights.caveat: High posting volume reflects marketing activity alongside formal product releases.

insights.title: Navblue Expands Skywise Collaboration with TransNusa
insights.finding: Navblue expanded its collaboration with TransNusa for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ to integrate flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and domestic routes in Indonesia.
insights.caveat: First agreement for these specific Skywise products in the region.
